Turning point: v=0 and speed=0 now, but acceleration and net force are nonzero. Do not apply the sign(v·a) speed rule at zero velocity.
Equilibrium crossing: acceleration and net force are zero at this instant, but velocity is not. This does not imply uniform motion afterward.
